summary: Read the full 1756-line diff (11 commits, 50 files) of surf/ui-polish-refine vs 3103286. The campaign is broadly coherent — the loading.tsx/PageSkeleton pattern, the cal→kcal rename, and most min-h-11 md:min-h-0 touch targets are applied uniformly. But three of the phase-5 sweeps (B1 touch targets, B3 focus indicator, B4 unit/number format) each leave a visible seam where the same defect-class was fixed two different ways or half-applied on lines the campaign itself edited, and B2's validation layer uses three different timing models across forms. No contradictory changes or leftover debug debris found.

seams.title: Same unit-spacing fix implemented with two different heuristics in two files
seams.evidence: Both hunks were added by this campaign to solve the identical problem (space before 'kcal', none before 'g'). macro-bar.tsx uses `{unit.length > 1 ? ` ${unit}` : unit}` while detail-surfaces.tsx TargetTile uses `{unit === "g" ? "g" : ` ${unit}`}` plus a second `{unit === "g" ? "g" : ""}` tail. Two idioms, one defect-class, same commit series (B4).
seams.suggested_fix: Pick one heuristic (unit === "g" is the clearer intent) or extract a tiny formatUnit(value, unit) helper and use it in both components.

seams.title: kcal standardization skips 'Avg cals' on a line the campaign edited
seams.evidence: B4 renamed every 'Cal'/'cal' label to 'kcal' across ~15 files, and this exact line was edited by the campaign (Math.round(...).toString() → .toLocaleString()) — yet its label stays `["Avg cals", ...]`. The identical pre-existing 'Avg cals' at src/app/app/progress/page.tsx:363 was also left, so the app now shows 'kcal' everywhere except these two tiles.
seams.suggested_fix: Rename both labels to match the new standard (e.g. 'Avg kcal'), or document why 'cals' survives.

seams.title: toLocaleString applied to some calorie values but not sibling values on campaign-edited lines
seams.evidence: B4's commit message is 'one unit and number format everywhere'. The campaign edited `{mealTotals.calories} cal` → `{mealTotals.calories} kcal` at dashboard-client 314/403 and `{meal.calories} kcal` at meal-plan 352 without adding .toLocaleString(), while the same commit added .toLocaleString() to remaining(), selectedTotals.calories, and detail-surfaces SmallStat (`item.calories.toLocaleString()`). A 1,200-kcal meal renders as '1200 kcal' in the dashboard meal list but '1,200' in the totals ring beside it.
seams.suggested_fix: Apply .toLocaleString() to the meal-level calorie values touched by the rename, or drop it everywhere below 4 digits — one rule.

seams.title: Three different idioms used for the B1 44px touch-target fix
seams.evidence: Most B1 fixes use `min-h-11 ... md:min-h-0` (mobile-only). But the log-drawer close button and food-search add button were fixed by bumping padding (p-2→p-3, p-2.5→p-3), which enlarges them on desktop too; mobile-header/user-menu use fixed `h-11 w-11` with a `-my-1.5` offset hack; series-toggle uses `md:min-h-9` instead of `md:min-h-0`; and button.tsx md size changed py-2.5→py-3, which persists on desktop even though min-h resets there — quietly changing desktop button height despite the 'layouts unchanged' promise. Pre-existing code (recipe-card.tsx:111, coach/page.tsx:614) uses plain `min-h-11` with no md reset, so the codebase now has four coexisting variants.
seams.suggested_fix: Standardize on `min-h-11 md:min-h-0` for the campaign's fixes; revert the padding-based bumps to min-h so desktop metrics are untouched, and revert button.tsx md padding to py-2.5.

seams.title: B3 focus-indicator upgrade (3px outline) does not reach Button, which keeps its own 2px ring
seams.evidence: globals.css :focus-visible was bumped 2px→3px and `outline-ring/50` removed from the base layer ('high-contrast keyboard focus indicator'). But button.tsx — a file this campaign edited on the same line — retains `focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2`, so every <Button> suppresses the new global indicator and shows the old 2px ring while adjacent links/inputs show the new 3px outline. Keyboard focus now looks visibly different between the app's most common control and everything else.
seams.suggested_fix: Either bump Button to ring-[3px] (or drop its outline-none and let the global outline apply) so the focus treatment is one style, or scope B3's claim.

seams.title: B2 inline validation uses three different timing models across forms
seams.evidence: All added by B2/R1: signup validates on blur and clears errors while typing (onBlur + validate-on-change-if-error, with focus management); progress's weight field computes weightError live on every keystroke — clearing the field instantly shows 'Enter a number, like 176.5.'; custom-meal-form shows nothing until first submit (`touched` flag); portion-picker errors live as you type. Same feature, four forms, three interaction models.
seams.suggested_fix: Pick one model (blur-validate + clear-on-fix, as signup does) and apply it to the weight field and portion picker; keep submit-gating only where a form has no blur boundary.

seams.title: Re-run intake link: redundant md:py-1.5 and tacked-on class ordering
seams.evidence: Campaign changed the class to `"min-h-11 self-start rounded-full bg-white px-3 py-1.5 ... md:min-h-0 md:py-1.5 inline-flex items-center"`. `md:py-1.5` is a no-op (base is already py-1.5), and `inline-flex items-center` is appended after the responsive variants instead of leading the string as in every other B1 edit (`inline-flex min-h-11 items-center ...`).
seams.suggested_fix: Drop md:py-1.5 and reorder to the campaign's own idiom: `inline-flex min-h-11 items-center ... md:min-h-0`.

seams.title: Error copy tone mixes terse-imperative and conversational within the new validation layer
seams.evidence: New copy ranges from terse ('Add a meal name.', 'Enter a password.') to conversational ('Amounts above 5,000 g usually mean a typo — double-check the number.', 'That doesn't look like an email address — check for typos.'). All introduced by this campaign; adjacent fields in the same flow can show both registers.
seams.suggested_fix: Settle on one register (the friendly-with-example style of 'Enter a number, like 176.5.' fits the brand) and normalize the handful of new strings.

seams.title: hasSupabaseConfig guard shaped differently in the two sibling coach routes
seams.evidence: Same commit adds the no-Supabase guard as an early return in history/route.ts (`if (!hasSupabaseConfig()) return Response.json(...)`) but as an inline nullable-client ternary in audit/route.ts (`hasSupabaseConfig() ? await createClient() : null` plus `user && supabase` checks). Audit's shape is partly forced by its preview fallback, but the divergence makes the two routes read as if written by different authors.
seams.suggested_fix: Optional: hoist a shared getOptionalUser() helper in preview-session.ts used by both routes, or add a one-line comment in audit/route.ts explaining why the early return doesn't apply.

summary: Walked dashboard, log, coach, daily-review, progress, recipes, settings, meal-plan, and signup at 1440x900 and 390x844 against the 3103286..HEAD diff. The campaign largely holds together: 44px touch targets use a consistent min-h-11/md:min-h-0 pattern, chip rows wrap cleanly on mobile, signup/custom-meal/portion errors share one red style, the 3px focus outline renders as a single coherent indicator (it wins over Button's own ring classes everywhere, so no double indicator), and the live greeting/kcal changes render correctly. Found two mid-level seams — the kcal standardization (B4) missed the two 'Avg cals' labels that now sit next to freshly-converted 'kcal' text, and the new progress weight validation fires an error the instant the field is cleared, unlike the blur/submit timing the same campaign gave signup and the custom-meal form — plus two nits.

seams.title: B4 'one unit everywhere' missed the two 'Avg cals' labels
seams.evidence: The campaign converted ~50 'cal' strings to 'kcal' (workout-library.ts, dashboard, log, daily-review tiles), but the meal-plan hero tile still renders 'AVG CALS' directly above meal rows the same diff changed to '{meal.calories} kcal' (meal-plan/page.tsx:351), and the progress StatTile still says 'Avg cals' on a page whose bars/tooltips the diff converted to kcal (macro-stacked-bars.tsx). Verified live: meal-plan mobile/desktop hero shows '1,641 AVG CALS' while the card below shows '360 kcal · 31g protein'; progress mobile shows '2,058 / Avg cals'. The diff even edited the adjacent value on meal-plan line 188 (added toLocaleString) but left the label.
seams.suggested_fix: Rename both labels to 'Avg kcal' (they are already uppercase-transformed tiles, matching the KCAL tile labels elsewhere).

seams.title: Progress weight field errors instantly on empty, unlike the validation timing the same campaign gave other forms
seams.evidence: weightError is computed reactively with no touched/blur gate: clearing the field to retype immediately shows the red border + role=alert 'Enter a number, like 176.5. The preview below uses your last logged weight.' (reproduced live at 390x844 and 1440x900). The same B2 commit gave signup blur-then-clear-on-fix validation (signup/page.tsx onBlur) and gave the custom meal form submit-gated validation (custom-meal-form.tsx `touched`). Three timings in one 'inline validation layer'; the eager-on-empty one flashes red at every user who clears the field mid-edit.
seams.suggested_fix: Suppress the error while the field is empty (keep the neutral 'preview only' caption, fall back to last logged weight silently), or gate it on blur like signup.

seams.title: Log food-search filter chips restyled to font-semibold, diverging from the font-black chip language used by equivalent filter rows elsewhere
seams.evidence: Diff changed the All/Favorites/Dislikes/Recently-used chips from 'text-xs font-black' to 'text-sm font-semibold' (measured live: weight 600 on log vs 900 for the recipes meal-filter chips, progress macro toggles, chart FilterButtons, and settings IntakePreferenceGroup chips, which all kept font-black in the same B1 pass). It now matches its DietFilterChips sibling row locally, but the identical-role filter row on recipes ('All/Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner') remains font-black, so the same control reads differently across the two pages.
seams.suggested_fix: Pick one chip spec for filter rows (either font-black like the rest of the pass, or migrate the recipes/settings/chart chips to the semibold spec) and apply it in one place.

seams.title: One generic PageSkeleton for 14 routes with distinct hero layouts
seams.evidence: B5 added identical loading.tsx files (light fw-page-header title/sub lines + 3 white 11rem cards) for coach, log, meal-plan, etc. Coach opens with a chat panel + composer and log/meal-plan open with a full-width dark-green hero card, so the flash-frame shape doesn't match those pages; the dashboard, by contrast, kept its bespoke skeleton (dark hero block + ring placeholder). Only visible as a brief flash on slow navigations (client pages, prefetch hides it in most cases), so it's a nit.
seams.suggested_fix: Add a dark hero-block variant of PageSkeleton (like dashboard's existing loading.tsx) for the routes that open with a dark hero (log, meal-plan, coach, recipes).

seams.title: Too-big-value errors speak in two different voices within the same logging flow
seams.evidence: Both messages are new in this diff. Portion picker with 99999 g shows the friendly, specific "Amounts above 5,000 g usually mean a typo — double-check the number." (portion-picker.tsx:139-142), live as you type. Custom meal form with calories=20000 and all other fields valid shows the blanket "Enter a number in every macro field (0–10,000 calories, 0–1,000 g per macro)." — verified live: the user HAS entered a number in every field, so the message misdescribes the problem, and it only appears after a submit attempt while the picker flags instantly.
seams.suggested_fix: In custom-meal-form, distinguish the over-max case from the missing/invalid case and reuse the portion picker's typo-hint voice, e.g. "Calories above 10,000 usually mean a typo — double-check the number."

seams.title: Progress weight field flashes a range error on the first keystroke; other new validation waits for blur or submit
seams.evidence: weightError is computed live from weightEntry with no touched/blur gating (diff added this block). Verified live: clearing the field and typing "1" (first char of a valid 176.5) immediately shows "Enter a weight between 50 and 1,000 lb. The preview below uses your last logged weight." in red. Signup (same campaign) deliberately validates on blur/submit and only clears live; custom meal form validates only on submit. Three timings across the three forms this campaign touched.
seams.suggested_fix: Gate the progress weight error behind blur (or a short debounce), matching the blur-then-clear-live pattern the campaign established on signup.

seams.title: Failed submit: signup moves focus to the invalid field, custom meal form drops focus and disables the button that was just clicked
seams.evidence: Signup's new submit handler focuses the first invalid input ((nextEmailError ? emailRef : passwordRef).current?.focus() — verified live, activeElement=email). Custom meal form's empty submit sets touched=true which makes disabled={touched && !canSubmit} kick in on the submit button itself; verified live that document.activeElement falls back to BODY, so a keyboard user loses their place entirely. Two invalid-submit treatments introduced by the same campaign.
seams.suggested_fix: In custom-meal-form, keep the submit button enabled (submit-guard already returns early) or focus the first invalid input on failed submit, mirroring the signup pattern.

seams.title: "Avg cals" label survived the B4 "one unit everywhere" pass — including on a line the pass itself edited
seams.evidence: Commit 94cd187 (B4 — one unit and number format everywhere) converted "cal"→"kcal" across ~10 files and touched this exact line (["Avg cals", ...toString()] → toLocaleString()) but left the "Avg cals" label. src/app/app/progress/page.tsx:370 has the same leftover "Avg cals" StatTile. Everywhere else in the app now reads kcal (verified via grep: no other bare cal/cals unit strings remain).
seams.suggested_fix: Rename both labels to "Avg kcal" (or "Avg calories") to finish the unit standardization.

seams.title: Escape now dismisses the user menu but not the ingredient drawer on the same page
seams.evidence: The diff added Escape + outside-click dismissal (with focus return) to UserMenu only. The log page's SessionIngredientDrawer — also touched by this diff (close-button padding p-2→p-3) — ignores Escape: verified live that after adding a meal opens the drawer, pressing Escape leaves it open. Two dismissible overlays on the same screen now respond differently to the same key.
seams.suggested_fix: Add the same Escape-to-close (and ideally focus-return) handler to SessionIngredientDrawer in src/app/app/log/page.tsx.

seams.title: Minimum weight is 60 lb in onboarding copy but 50 lb in progress validation
seams.evidence: New onboarding hint (onboarding/page.tsx:369): "Enter your height (3 ft or more) and weight (60 lb or more) to continue." (matches pre-existing canProceed >= 60). New progress validation accepts 50–1,000 lb: "Enter a weight between 50 and 1,000 lb." Both weight-entry bounds surfaced to users were written in this campaign and disagree on the floor.
seams.suggested_fix: Pick one floor (60 lb) and use it in both the progress bounds and its error copy, or extract a shared constant.

summary: Exercised all requested flows live (signup bad/good input, search→portion→add incl. 99999g, custom meal form open/close/submit, keyboard-Tab on dashboard and log, onboarding steps 0-3, progress weight junk). The campaign is largely cohesive: kcal + toLocaleString formatting is consistent, focus outlines are uniformly 3px including on dark panels, onboarding proceed-hints are coherent and aria-live, both add paths give identical ingredient-drawer feedback, and no console/hydration errors surfaced. Six seams found, all inconsistencies between changes the campaign itself introduced: three moderate (error-message voice diverges between portion picker and custom meal form for the same too-big-value case; validation timing is keystroke-live on progress vs blur on signup vs submit-only on custom meal; failed-submit focus handling differs — signup focuses the invalid field while custom meal drops focus to body and disables its own submit button) and three nits ("Avg cals" label survived the one-unit pass on a line that pass edited; Escape closes the new user menu but not the ingredient drawer; 60 lb vs 50 lb weight floors in two campaign-authored strings).
